composition: centered original head-and-shoulders anime avatar; readable iris motifs; circular-crop safe
creative_direction: Create a close portrait of Conan Edogawa with his characteristic hair tuft, round glasses, blue jacket, and red bow tie. Preserve his small child proportions and youthful face. He raises one hand in a low friendly wave, while the glasses remain transparent with no glare across either eye. Use clean cel shading and broad sky-blue and ivory background planes. His expression is alert and cheerful without a theatrical grin. Keep the head large enough for avatar readability, but avoid oversized baby features. The hand and bow tie are supporting accents, with no gadget or other prop. Both visible irises contain a clear red Sharingan design with three small black comma marks and a normal dark pupil; keep bright catchlights and the friendly expression. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
